name: Coffee Pub Chameleon
tagline: One place for the whole group.
description: A private place for your group. Chat all week, call when it counts, and keep the plans, the maps and the notes right beside it. A space can be a trip, a campaign or a project.
pitch: Chat all week, call when it counts, and keep the plans, the maps and the notes right beside it. Yours, on your own address.

features.title: A chat and a call for every space
features.text: A space is a place to meet: a chat that stays open, a call when you want one, and the modules you turn on for it.

features.title: Trips
features.text: Plan the trip with the people coming. Put flights and stays on the plan, drop the places you like on the map, vote on where to eat, and split the costs at the end.

features.title: Game nights
features.text: One space for each campaign, with side conversations for whispers and a calendar for session nights. For a stream, every player is an OBS source: their camera on a clear background, with a border that lights up when they talk.

features.title: Projects and mentoring
features.text: Plan a product or design project with the people on it and talk the problem through. Keep the tasks, the dates and the research in one space. Or run a mentoring group: meet for each session, vote on what to cover next, and keep the notes.

features.title: The tools beside the chat
features.text: A plan, places and a map, a calendar, to-do, polls, a budget, and notes and research your group can find again.

features.title: Yours, and private
features.text: No ads, and nobody selling what you say. Your people, plans and files live in your own environment and are not shared with anyone else's. Guests can come into a space with just a name, when you allow it. You can also run it on your own server.
